               <lb n="47a2"/>pa dang ma 'brangs pa 2 las dang po ni rjes yin la 2 pa yid spyod yine de ltar na tshad la ma yin pi blo lnga tshad ma'i blo 2 bdun du grengs pa yino | zhes bzhod <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5564">rigs pa'i gter</rs> las deg la dbab pa mdzad pi tshul ni gl sdang la mongs pa | tshad ma min na mngon kun | tshad ma min 'gyur
